# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Choreoform contributors

# Small specification fixture, not an executable benchmark.
Choreoform authoring "0.19.0".
Process "Terminal example".
  Start at "Done".
  Inputs empty.
  Outputs empty.
  Outcomes ["complete"].
  Use cancellation "Stop", faults "Fault handling", closure "Close" and races "Commit order".
  Require actor "Reviewer" under "Reviewer requirement".
  Rule for actor "Reviewer requirement".
    Permit when (true).
  End policy.
  Rule for cancel "Stop".
    Authority "Reviewer".
    For children use "Settle".
  End policy.
  Rule for settlement "Settle".
    Unfinished work cancel.
  End policy.
  Rule for faults "Fault handling".
    Handle empty.
  End policy.
  Rule for closure "Close".
    Fully terminal.
  End policy.
  Rule for race "Commit order".
    Accept in acceptance order.
  End policy.
  Step "Done".
    Finish as "complete".
  End step.
Rule for protection "Access". Permit access when (true). End policy.
Keep "Value" as whole number, protected as "Shared protection". Invalidate empty. Initially unavailable. End data.
Protect data as "Shared protection". Under "Access". Sensitivity "test". Purposes ["Use"]. Participants ["Reviewer"]. Capabilities empty. End protection.
Let "Read condition" mean (test "Same" using ["Value" is (the value of "Value")]) as truth value with parameters empty. Define test "Same" with inputs ["Value" as whole number]. It holds when ((the parameter "Value") equals (the parameter "Value")). End test. Let "Opaque example" mean ("Same") as text with parameters empty. Describe type "Counter" as whole number. End process.
